acceptance_criteria.text: Open the app on mobile portrait (360x740) and desktop (1440x900) -> The top Header bar is not rendered and main page content starts at the top of the viewport (covers B1)
Inspect the UI and codebase -> The bug button (🐛) is absent, DebugPanel is removed from Layout and deleted, and localStorage 'pifitness-debug' is no longer toggled (covers B2)
Navigate to Admin -> Theme tab on mobile (360x740) and desktop (1440x900) -> The ThemeToggle button is rendered on its own admin page and toggles between light and dark mode (covers B3)
